summary: Realign stale task tracking to the live FD-001 Phase 0 masterplan and implement CS-CLOUD-IAM-001: a pure-domain metadata-only identity-provider registry snapshot port plus in-memory repository whose persist boundary revalidates snapshot invariants, records required IdP/federation metadata, rejects raw provider/credential/assertion/STS material, and constrains provider evidence refs to allowlisted opaque reference schemes.

baseline_diff.before: tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md described a stale M01-observability hyperscaler gap-closure plan. Cloud IAM provider sync receipts existed, but no durable metadata-only registry snapshot port or duplicate/idempotency guard existed in the domain crate.
baseline_diff.red_test: cargo test -p oya-cloud-iam-domain idp_registry_snapshot -- --nocapture failed before implementation with missing IdentityProviderRegistrySnapshot, raw-material counters, in-memory repository, and CloudIamError variants.
baseline_diff.after: Cloud IAM domain exposes IdentityProviderRegistrySnapshotRepository, IdentityProviderRegistrySnapshot, metadata-only records/counters, and an in-memory repository. Registry records preserve the required metadata envelope: tenant, identity provider, kind, region pack, issuer/audience refs, verification-material ref, provider evidence ref, operation/status, actor, idempotency key, and occurred timestamp without raw provider/credential/assertion/STS material. The repository persist boundary rechecks public snapshot invariants: non-empty records, valid snapshot/tenant refs, record tenant match, duplicate idempotency, duplicate provider records, metadata-only counters, safe actor/ref fields, and allowlisted provider evidence refs. API error mapping handles the new domain variants exhaustively. Task plan now follows masterplan/sequencing Phase 0 starting with Cloud IAM.

best_practice_research.question: FD-001 Phase 0 Cloud IAM hyperscaler patterns and anti-patterns for IdP federation, short-lived credentials, API-first contracts, and SLO evidence.

official_upstream_sources.establishes: Federation, temporary credentials, MFA, least privilege, access analysis, and periodic permission/credential review are IAM baselines.
Temporary credentials are short-term, dynamically generated, and the basis for roles/federation; avoid embedded long-term credentials.
Least-privilege external identity impersonation grants avoid privilege expansion in workload identity federation.
Identity domains carry users, roles, SSO, SAML/OAuth IdP administration, MFA/security settings, and administrative isolation boundaries.
SLOs/SLIs/error budgets support evidence-based reliability and rollout decisions; avoid absolute 100% promises.
OpenAPI contracts bind to declared spec releases and OpenAPI itself follows semantic versioning.

best_practice_research.implementation_handoff: CS-CLOUD-IAM-001 keeps the domain metadata-only, rejects raw/token material, preserves IdP evidence refs instead of credentials, and leaves concrete provider/database adapters to later outer-layer ChangeSets.
